title: Components, materials and coordination expansion
objective: Extend the verified CAD/BIM product from the compatibility-grade reusable components/materials/coordination baseline into a bounded professional parity layer, preserving frozen ConstructionOS Architecture v1.1.
acceptance_criteria: Representative reusable component definitions produce stable canonical definition/instance relationships extending COMPAT-BIM-003.
Definition edits propagate deterministically, create immutable revisions and preserve per-instance overrides.
Material definitions and assignments are canonical, deterministic and engine-independent with explicit type-vs-instance precedence.
Coordination sets, grids and supported references persist through save/open/replay deterministically.
Construction Graph mappings use document-owned canonical identities; engine-native ids remain provenance only.
Web and Electron produce equivalent semantic streams and canonical results for representative P012 workflows.
IFC import/export preserves supported component/material semantics and reports explicit LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED outcomes.
CAD-PARITY-002..011, COMPAT-BIM-003 and COMPAT-IFC-001 fixtures remain green and byte-identical unless explicitly reviewed.
Real OCCT/IFC behavior remains behind the EngineAdapterBundle/worker boundary.
The exact final implementation head is CI-verified and browser/Electron verified.
No protected architecture paths are modified.
non_goals: Architecture changes without an explicit ACR.
risk_assumptions: CAD-PARITY-011 is VERIFIED after ARCH-WF-002 reconciliation.
COMPAT-BIM-003 is VERIFIED and is the compatibility-grade baseline.
RESEARCH-CAD-007 is VERIFIED and establishes engine-independent semantics and the replaceable adapter boundary.
COMPAT-IFC-001 is VERIFIED and provides the production IFC exchange baseline.
Architecture v1.1 remains frozen throughout P012.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic component-definition/instance, propagation, material, coordination and revision tests.
Web/Electron parity fixtures for representative P012 workflows.
Real-OCCT/IFC coverage through the existing adapter/worker boundary.
Regression proof for CAD-PARITY-002..011, COMPAT-BIM-003 and COMPAT-IFC-001.
Exact-head Vercel deployment and real-browser/Electron evidence.
Revision-bound governance evidence covering final implementation and post-merge verification.
